concepts.title: Raft Consensus Algorithm
concepts.summary: Leader election, log replication, and safety invariants in distributed replicated state machines. Relies on randomized election timers to avoid split votes.
concepts.raw_notes:
Notes from tutorial:
- Heartbeats prevent follower timeouts
- Candidate increments currentTerm and votes for self
- Stumbled when reading section 5.2: what happens when leader gets disconnected during log entry commit? Need to understand how follower truncates uncommitted entries upon rejoin.

concepts.title: Distributed Quorums (W + R > N)
concepts.summary: Strict quorum consistency model guaranteeing that the read set and write set always overlap by at least one node, ensuring monotonic reads of latest writes.
concepts.raw_notes: If N=3, W=2, R=2: overlap is guaranteed (2+2=4 > 3). Write to 2 nodes, read from 2 nodes, highest timestamp wins.
concepts.last_friction_point: Reconciling concurrent timestamp clocks (Lamport vs Vector clocks) under sloppy quorums.
concepts.suggested_next_step: Review Dynamo paper section on hinted handoff and anti-entropy with Merkle trees.

concepts.title: React Fiber Architecture & Work Loop
concepts.summary: React 18+ reconciler breaking synchronous recursive tree traversal into cooperative units of work using requestIdleCallback / MessageChannel scheduler.
concepts.raw_notes:
Two phases:
1. Render Phase (reconciliation): pure, no side effects, interruptible by higher-priority events
2. Commit Phase: mutations to real DOM, runs synchronously
Friction: Mixed up lane priorities and why useEffect runs asynchronously after layout.
concepts.last_friction_point: Need sharper clarity on failure recovery phases.
concepts.suggested_next_step: Diagram the flow on paper without checking documentation.

concepts.title: B-Tree vs LSM-Tree Storage Engines
concepts.summary: Tradeoffs between in-place page updates (B-Trees in Postgres/InnoDB) and append-only sequential writes with background compactions (LSM-Trees in RocksDB/Cassandra).
concepts.raw_notes:
B-Tree:
- Good for read-heavy workloads
- Random write page splits require WAL
LSM-Tree:
- High write throughput, MemTable -> SSable
- Read amplification mitigated by Bloom filters
concepts.last_friction_point: Quantifying write amplification factor during leveled compaction vs size-tiered compaction.
concepts.suggested_next_step: Calculate write amplification for a 10MB write in a 4-level LSM tree.

concepts.title: Database Indexing & B+ Trees
concepts.summary: Multi-level self-balancing tree structure where leaves contain all keys linked sequentially, optimized for block storage reads and range scans.
concepts.raw_notes: High fan-out means low tree height (depth 3-4 holds billions of records). Clustered vs non-clustered index lookup costs.
concepts.last_friction_point: Composite index prefix matching rules on range queries.
concepts.suggested_next_step: Explain to a junior engineer how covering indexes eliminate table heap lookups.

concepts.title: Kubernetes Pod Lifecycle & Eviction
concepts.summary: Pod phase transitions (Pending -> Running -> Succeeded/Failed), termination grace period (preStop hook -> SIGTERM -> SIGKILL), and kubelet eviction thresholds.
concepts.raw_notes: Debugged a production 502 error during rolling update. Service endpoint controller removes pod IP asynchronously, so traffic was still sent while container was shutting down!
concepts.last_friction_point: Need sharper clarity on failure recovery phases.
concepts.suggested_next_step: Diagram the flow on paper without checking documentation.

concepts.title: Linux Namespaces & Cgroups
concepts.summary: Underlying Linux kernel primitives that form containers: PID/NET/MNT namespaces for visibility boundaries, cgroups v2 for CPU/memory resource limits.
concepts.raw_notes: Containers are just processes! `unshare` command creates new namespaces. OOM killer targets cgroup memory.max exceeders.
concepts.last_friction_point: Understanding cgroups v1 vs v2 unified hierarchy implications on Java 8 heap sizing.
concepts.suggested_next_step: Write a 20-line bash script creating a mini chroot container with isolated PID namespace.

concepts.title: OAuth 2.0 PKCE Flow
concepts.summary: Proof Key for Code Exchange protocol preventing authorization code interception attacks on public clients (SPAs and mobile apps) without client secrets.
concepts.raw_notes: Client generates code_verifier (random string) and code_challenge (SHA-256 base64url). Auth server verifies challenge hash upon code exchange.
concepts.last_friction_point: Proper token storage security tradeoffs in browser (HttpOnly cookies vs in-memory with refresh token rotation).
concepts.suggested_next_step: Draft an architectural diagram of Token Refresh rotation with replay detection.

concepts.title: SQL optimization guide  SELECT users id
concepts.summary: System overview and operational principles of SQL optimization guide  SELECT users id. Addresses design tradeoffs, concurrency, and reliability invariants.
concepts.raw_notes:
SQL optimization guide:
SELECT users.id, orders.total FROM users
INNER JOIN orders ON users.id = orders.user_id
WHERE orders.status = 'completed' AND orders.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY users.id, orders.total
HAVING COUNT(orders.id) > 2
ORDER BY orders.total DESC LIMIT 50;
Indexes used: B-Tree on user_id, Composite Index on (status, created_at).
